column5: ice impact: the frost flower crystals burst outward bigger, glint, then crack into small shards that fade away
freezing hit: the frost crust grows thicker and spikier around the center, then cracks and crumbles away into tiny ice bits
electric chain hit: the discharge flashes brighter, the side bolts jump further left and right with new zigzag shapes, then fade out
seamless looping ball lightning: the electric arcs around the orb crackle and jump to new positions, orb stays the same size
lightning strike: the bolt flashes at full brightness, flickers with new branches, then thins out and fades from top to bottom
lightning ground impact: the flash bursts wide, bolts splash up and outward, then fade leaving only a dark scorch mark
crown discharge: the crown spikes crackle and flare up taller with electric sparks, then fade out
arcane pillar erupts: the column of magic blocks shoots up, the blocks break apart and float upward, then fade out
electric bolt flickering: the zigzag line jumps into new jagged shapes each frame, same length and position
thick lightning bolt flickering: the zigzag bolt jumps into new jagged shapes and the golden knots pulse, same length and position
